findings.description: For f(x)=-4x+3, statements are I: not a function; II: many-to-one; III: one-to-one. The bank contains II+III, I, I+II, I+III and III. Function status eliminates every I option, and mutual exclusivity eliminates II+III. III only is forced because II only is absent. This affects both generator families.
